description:
fz-odj placed each Kernel extern defp directly after the def that calls it. Do the same for the other lib modules that declare externs: atom, file, float, integer, map, process, string, string_chars, utf8.

An extern called by several defs sits after the first def (clause family) that uses it, where a reader first meets it; within a group, externs are listed in order of first use. Comments attached to an extern move with it.

This is a pure reordering: the set of declarations and every body are unchanged.
title: lib: each extern defp sits directly after the def that uses it, in every module
